from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashReport(BaseModel):
    """A company's Cash and Cash Equivalents at End of Period from one financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in this financial report")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical cash value as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written in the document, e.g. 'Cash and cash equivalents'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered, e.g. 'March 31, 2024'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document showing the cash figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_reports: list[CompanyCashReport]
